rows.role_title: National Convenor of the Aam Aadmi Party
rows.text: The party's letter of 29 May 2015 to the Election Commission says 'Aam Aadmi Party’s first election for the office bearers was conducted on' a day typed 24.11.2012 and altered by hand to 25, and its annexure A-1 gives 25.11.2012 as the 'Date on which last Election Held', 'ARVIND KEJRIWAL (NATIONAL CONVENOR)' as the first of the office bearers elected and 'Nov-15' as the date the next election was due.
